$comment: Shared numbers for Glow. Nobody hardcodes these. scripts/codegen.sh turns this file into server/src/contracts/constants.ts, ios/Packages/GlowKit/Sources/APIClient/Generated/GlowConstants.swift and supabase/tests/database/000_constants.test.sql. The database keeps its own copy in private.constants, and that generated test fails until a migration updates it to match. Durations are whole seconds or milliseconds, as the unit says.

CHECKIN_TTL.description: How long a check-in lasts (3 hours). Cut short if the room ends first.

CHECKIN_EXPIRY_WARNING.description: checkin.expiring is sent this long before a check-in ends (15 minutes).

TAP_TTL.description: How long a tap lasts (24 hours).

TAPS_PER_ROOM_PER_DAY.description: Taps per person per room per day, in the room's timezone.

CARD_VIEWS_PER_ROOM_PER_DAY.description: Different cards a person can be shown per room per day. Seeing the same card again is free.

CARD_VIEW_RETENTION.description: Card view records are purged after 48 hours.

GEO_MAX_ACCURACY.description: Location fixes less accurate than this are rejected (try again).

GEO_ACCURACY_CREDIT.description: Up to this much of a fix's reported accuracy is subtracted from its distance to the room's center.

GEO_FRESHNESS_FOR_GLOW.description: Both people need a passed location check this recent before a glow starts (2 minutes).

LOCATION_FIX_TIMEOUT.description: How long the app waits for one fresh location fix.

LOCATION_CHECK_RETENTION.description: Pass or fail records of location checks are purged after 24 hours.

CHOICE_WINDOW.description: Time each person has to choose Find or Chat after a match (10 minutes).

GLOW_TTL.description: How long a glow lasts (15 minutes).

GLOW_ENDED_RETENTION.description: Ended glow sessions are kept this long so both apps can read how they ended, then purged.

QR_ROTATION.description: A screen's QR token changes every 30 seconds.

QR_ACCEPTED_WINDOWS.description: Rotating QR windows accepted: the current one and the previous one.

QR_TOKEN_LENGTH.description: A rotating QR token is the first 8 base32 characters of HMAC-SHA256(room secret, window).

JOIN_TICKET_TTL.description: A join ticket from a passed location check lasts 10 minutes.

CARD_URL_TTL.description: A signed card image link lasts 60 seconds.

MODERATION_TIMEOUT.description: Moderation gives up after 2.5 seconds. Chat messages then go through and are reviewed afterwards. Card photos fail closed.

PURGE_INTERVAL.description: The purge cron runs every 5 minutes.

PROFILE_PHOTOS_MIN.description: Fewest profile photos to finish onboarding.

ROOM_CODE_LENGTH.description: Room codes are 6 characters from ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789.

REPORT_DETAILS_MAX_CHARS.description: Longest free-text detail on a report.

REPORT_EVIDENCE_MESSAGES.description: A match or chat report keeps the reported person's last 20 messages for review.

PHOTO_MAX_DIMENSION.description: Longest side of an uploaded photo.

FACE_BOX_GROWTH.description: Each detected face box grows by this much on every side before blurring.
